name: find-skills
tagline_zh: 当你说“能不能帮我做X”，它翻遍技能库找到现成方案。别人还在写代码，你已经装好即用。
tagline_en: When you ask 'can you do X', it digs the skill library for a ready-made fix. No coding, just install and go.
desc_en: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.
why_zh: 它不猜需求，而是精准匹配仓库里的真实技能，连安装命令都给你备好，省去搜索和试错。
why_en: It matches your request to real installable skills from the repo, complete with commands—no guesswork, no wasted searches.
